outer_cv.aggregation: Mean of available out-of-fold predictions for each participant.

inner_cv.purpose: Expert OOF predictions, support and counterfactual signals

meta_cv.purpose: Cross-fitted logistic calibration of logit consensus

calibration.method: Conditional logistic regression on logit probabilities
acceptance: ECE increases by no more than 0.002
AUPRC decreases by no more than 0.001

bootstrap.paired_comparisons: Shared bootstrap index for proposed and comparator probabilities
bootstrap.pvalue: Two-sided empirical AUPRC tail proportion, floored at 1/N_BOOT; Holm adjustment across comparators

threshold_evaluation.method: Five-fold cross-fitting on participant-averaged OOF predictions
threshold_evaluation.objective: Balanced accuracy, then sensitivity, then specificity

model_predict_threshold: Separate internal ROC Youden threshold fitted to inner probabilities

conformal.referral: Empty or two-class set, or uncertainty above selected reliability cutoff
conformal.coverage_note: Nominal class error settings do not establish empirical coverage or a separate split-conformal guarantee.

reliability.selection_fallback: If sensitivity target is infeasible, select among remaining eligible candidates; if none, cutoff=1.

stress_tests.application: Perturb held-out fold only; train on unchanged training fold.
